SELECT highest_education, 
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN final_result IN ('Pass', 'Distinction') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_rate
FROM studentInfo
GROUP BY highest_education
ORDER BY 
  CASE highest_education
    WHEN 'Post Graduate Qualification' THEN 1
    WHEN 'HE Qualification' THEN 2
    WHEN 'A Level or Equivalent' THEN 3
    WHEN 'Lower Than A Level' THEN 4
    WHEN 'No Formal quals' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END;
